MAHATRANSCO Electrician Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 25 Posts - Complete Details

The Maharashtra State Electricity Transmission Company (MSETCL) Recruitment 2026 for posts of 25 Electrician Apprentice. Candidates with ITI Can Apply Online. The online application opens on 18-09-2026, and closes on 30-09-2026. The candidate shall apply online through MSETCL website, mahatransco.in.

Important Dates

  • Online Application Start Date : 18 September 2026
  • Online Application Last Date : 30 September 2026 up to 11:59 PM
  • Last Date for Hard Copy : 15 October 2026 up to 6:00 PM
  • Last date to submit online application : 30 September 2026 up to 11:59 PM
  • Last date for submitting application printout and documents : 15 October 2026 up to 6:00 PM
  • General candidates : 18 to 38 years
  • Eligible backward-class candidates : Relaxation of 5 years in the upper-age limit

Application Fee

  • Post Name : Electrician Apprentice
  • Online Application Start Date : 18 September 2026
  • Online Application Last Date : 30 September 2026 up to 11:59 PM
  • Last Date for Hard Copy : 15 October 2026 up to 6:00 PM
  • Last date to submit online application : 30 September 2026 up to 11:59 PM
  • Last date for submitting application printout and documents : 15 October 2026 up to 6:00 PM
  • Establishment : Trade
  • General candidates : 18 to 38 years
  • SSC marks : 50%

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
